batchUpload.subtitle: Ongeraho amafoto menshi y'ikintu cyawe mu bice bitandukanye. Amafoto asobanutse afasha mu kukimenya.

batchUpload.drag_to_reorder: Kurura kugira ngo uhindure uko amafoto akurikirana
batchUpload.tips: Inama: Shyiraho amafoto asobanutse, afite urumuri rwiza mu bice bitandukanye. Urashobora gukurura amafoto kugira ngo uhindure uko akurikirana, maze ifoto ya mbere ibe ariyo igaragara bwa nyuma.

preferences.smsNotificationsDesc: Jya ubona ubutumwa bw'umutekano n'ibyo kugarura ibintu kuri SMS.

preferences.currencyDescription: Rikoreshwa mu kwerekana amafaranga wishyura n'amateka y'ubwishyu.

faqs_page.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa
faqs_page.subtitle: Byose ukeneye kumenya kuri KIZERE

questions.what_is_kizere_ans: KIZERE ni urubuga rwa mbere rwuzuye mu Rwanda rwo kwandikisha ibintu, kumenyesha ibyabuze n'ibyabonetse, no gucunga uburenganzira bwo gutunga. Dufasha kubaka umuco w'ubwizerane n'umutekano.
questions.is_it_free_ans: Gufungura konti isanzwe ni ubuntu. Kurinda ikintu cyo mu giciro cy'ibanze bishingiye kuri 2,000 RWF gusa.
questions.how_to_register_ans: Injira muri konti, kanda 'Andika Ikintu', maze ukurikize intambwe: tanga amakuru, shyiraho amafoto, kandi wemeze inyandiko z'uburenganzira.
questions.what_is_digital_cert_ans: Ni inyandiko yirinzwe mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga yemeza ko uri nyir'ikintu. Ikubiyemo amakuru y'ikintu, amafoto, n'ikiranga cyihariye.
questions.what_if_i_lose_it: Nyakora iki niba nataye ikintu cyanjye?
questions.what_if_i_lose_it_ans: Jya kuri 'Byabuze & Byabonetse', tanga raporo y'ikintu cyabuze, maze ugaragaze aho giheruka kuboneka n'igihe. Ubwenge bukorano bwacu n'abaturage bizagufasha kugishakisha.
questions.is_my_data_safe_ans: Yego, dukoresha uburyo bwo kurinda amakuru bwo ku rwego rwa banki kandi twubahiriza amateka y'u Rwanda ajyanye no kurinda amakuru bwite.

faqs_page.contact_us_text: Uragifite ibindi bibazo? Turi hano kugira n’ugufashe kurinda ibintu byawe by'agaciro.

about_page.title: Kuri KIZERE
about_page.mission_text: Kubaka umuryango ukoresha ukuri kandi wizewe mu gutunga no kugarura ibintu mu Rwanda binyuze mu mishinga y'ikoranabuhanga.
about_page.vision_text: Kuba icyitegererezo mu kwemeza uburenganzira bwo gutunga no kugarura ibyabuze muri Afurika y'Iburasirazuba.
about_page.story_text: Yatangiye i Kigali, KIZERE yavutse biturutse ku kenerwa rya sisitemu imwe yizewe yo gucunga ibikoresho no gufasha kugarura ibyabuze mu mujyi wacu ukura vuba.

blog_page.title: Inkuru za KIZERE
blog_page.subtitle: Inama z'umutekano, inkuru z'intsinzi, n'amakuru mashya

post1.title: Uburyo bwo Kurinda Smartphone yawe i Kigali
post1.excerpt: Inama zifatika zo kugira ngo telefone yawe y'agaciro igume mu mutekano mu mujyi wacu ukura.

post2.title: Cyabonetse: Inkuru y'Intsinzi ivuye i Musanze
post2.excerpt: Uburyo tableti yari yabuze yasubijwe nyirayo mu masaha 48 hakoreshejwe KIZERE.

post3.title: KIZERE Version 0.1: Ibiranga bishya
post3.excerpt: Kureba ibiranga bishya n'iterambere mu kuvugurura urubuga rwacu.

docs_page.welcome_text: Izi nyandiko zateganyijwe kugira ngo zigufashe gukoresha KIZERE mu buryo bwiza cyane. Waba uri umukoresha mushya ushaka kurinda ibyawe cyangwa uri umukozi ufasha mu kugarura ibyabuze, uzasanga byose hano.
docs_page.tip_text: Koresha ahantu ho gushakira hejuru kugira ngo ubone amakuru ku kintu icyo ari cyo cyose cyanditse cyangwa ubufasha ukeneye.
docs_page.concept1_text: Buri kintu muri KIZERE gifite umwirondoro wihariye w'ikoranabuhanga ari uwawe bwite.
docs_page.concept2_text: Uburyo bwacu bwo kugarura ibintu bishingiye ku baturage bufasha ibintu kubona ba nyirabyo.
docs_page.quick_start_desc: Kuva ku busa kugeza wanditse ikintu mu gihe kitageze ku minota 5.
docs_page.security_desc: Menya uko turinda ibintu byawe n'amakuru yawe bwite.

network.title: Umuryango w'Ubwizerane
network.description: KIZERE ni rurenga urubuga; ni umuryango w'ubwizerane. Intego yacu ni ukurema ahantu hirinzwe aho ibyabuze bibona inzira itaha mu rugo.

guidelines.title: Amabwiriza y'Umuryango
guidelines.rule1: Koresha ukuri kandi ugaragarize raporo zawe.
